import ast
import pathlib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from types import SimpleNamespace

path = pathlib.Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\ccr.py')
source = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:token-master-plugin/skills/token-master/brainspace/ccr.py'], text=True)
def load_stats(text):
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    cls = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'CCR')
    method = next(node for node in cls.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'stats')
    namespace = {'_STORAGE_ERRORS': (sqlite3.Error, OSError)}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), '<stats>', 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace['stats']
old, new = load_stats(original), load_stats(source)
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.executescript('''
CREATE TABLE ccr_v2(scope, orig_bytes, blob, hits);
CREATE TABLE ccr_leases(scope, hash, session);
CREATE TABLE ccr_evictions(scope, hash, reason);
INSERT INTO ccr_v2 VALUES ('own', 20, 'abc', 2);
INSERT INTO ccr_evictions VALUES ('own', 'a', 'evicted'), ('own', 'b', 'expired'), ('other', 'c', 'evicted');
''')
obj = SimpleNamespace(_connect=lambda: conn, _scope_key='own', _db_path='test', shared=False, last_gc=None)
queries = []
conn.set_trace_callback(queries.append)
assert new(obj) == old(obj) == new(obj, include_evictions=False)
assert not any('ccr_evictions' in query for query in queries)
assert new(obj, include_evictions=True) == dict(old(obj), evicted_records=2)
obj._scope_key = 'empty'
assert new(obj, include_evictions=True)['evicted_records'] == 0
conn.execute('DROP TABLE ccr_evictions')
assert 'error' not in new(obj)
assert new(obj, include_evictions=True) == dict(entries=0, db_path='test', error='unreadable', last_gc=None, evicted_records=0)
def fail():
    raise sqlite3.OperationalError('unreadable')
obj._connect = fail
assert new(obj) == old(obj)
assert new(obj, include_evictions=True) == dict(old(obj), evicted_records=0)
try:
    new(obj, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('parameter must be keyword-only')
conn.close()
print('Focused stats checks passed')
'@ | python -B -; git diff --check; git status --short
